tip: Dropping denn into a question makes it sound curious and friendly rather than blunt: warum fragst du denn softens the tone without adding meaning.
Reported speech shifts to subjunctive I: beweise instead of beweist marks the statement as the professor's claim, not the narrator's own fact.
Here eben means just or simply and marks resigned acceptance: dann machen wir es eben so signals giving in to how things are.
The verb bedürfen takes a genitive object: es bedarf einer gründlichen Analyse. It is a formal way of saying something is needed.
In a yes/no question, etwa adds disbelief and expects the answer no: hast du etwa die Torte gegessen carries a note of accusation.
As a particle ruhig means go ahead or it would have been fine to: du hättest ruhig etwas sagen können. It has nothing to do with quiet.
